content:
You don't say whether you let it 'restart to update'. Did you? Have you rebooted the computer? Does Thunderbird otherwise work as it should?

If the answer to all those is Yes, I'd blame the symptoms on a botched upgrade. I'd try the following (make a backup copy of your Thunderbird Profile first; see <https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/thunderbird-export> for how to do that):

- Download the installer for the same version from <https://www.thunderbird.net/en-US/thunderbird/all/> and install it over the current installation.

- If that doesn't improve the situation I'd uninstall the current version, reboot the computer, then reinstall Thunderbird.

content:
Your problem is caused by https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2071951 "Thunderbird hangs on startup when restoring session.json." By default Thunderbird always proceeds to a session restore on startup. Actually in certain cases when many messages and/or PDF documents opened in new tabs are left open on closing Thunderbird, it will be unable to restore them on next startup.

Unless this bug gets fixed the only way I know to recover a responding Thunderbird app is to remove the session.json file in the Thunderbird profile folder. To do this you can follow the description I provided in this discussion https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/questions/1613132#answer-1858261 If my instructions seem imprecise please ask me before trying some other manoeuvre .
